description: List the organization's Endpoint Storage: S3-compatible buckets Edgegap exports container logs to when a deployment ends (so logs survive the deployment), and the pull profiles under each, which copy files from the bucket into a container at boot. Secret keys are never returned. A version uses a storage for logs through edgegap_create_app_version / edgegap_update_app_version endpoint_storage, and a pull profile through edgegap_link_pull_profile.
name: edgegap_list_endpoint_storage
title: List Endpoint Storage and pull profiles
